title: Polish topologies on endomorphism monoids of linear orders
summary: In this paper, we investigate Polish semigroup topologies on the endomorphism monoids $\operatorname{End}(\mathbb{N},\leq)$ and $\operatorname{End}(\mathbb{Z},\leq)$. We introduce a new structural condition, property $\mathbb{XX}$, which yields automatic continuity of Borel measurable homomorphisms between certain topological semigroups. This provides a new method for analyzing Polish semigroup topologies on monoids with small groups of units.
